subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write x. One line slides down this way. One line slides down that way. They cross!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says x, as in fox.
This letter says x. Say the sound!
Trace x with your finger. Slide down one way, then slide down the other way.
Look carefully. Which one is x? Two lines that cross.

hints: x is two lines that cross in the middle.
Start at the top. Slide down one way, then the other.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write x.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Slide down, slide up. Look, I wrote x!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is v. x has two lines that cross.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. One line this way, one line that way. That is x!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter x, say its sound and trace it.
